# criblio_guard_rule (Data Source)

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "criblio_guard_rule" "my_guard_rule" {
  group_id = "default"
  id       = "employee_badge_id"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Worker group ID.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the SDS rule.

### Read-Only

- `context_keywords` (Attributes List) Context keywords that help match sensitive data for this rule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--context_keywords))
- `description` (String) Brief description of the SDS rule.
- `lib` (String) Name of the library that the rule belongs to.
- `regex` (String) Regular expression pattern used to match sensitive data.
- `rulesets` (List of String) Rulesets that the rule belongs to.

<a id="nestedatt--context_keywords"></a>
### Nested Schema for `context_keywords`

Read-Only:

- `keyword` (String) Keyword that provides additional context to help match sensitive data for the rule.
- `placement` (String) Position of the keyword relative to the match: <code>before</code> or <code>after</code>.
